text: status: queued or waiting (not started yet), then applied, applied_with_differences, applied_unchecked, stopped or refused (jobs); queued, then applied or failed (gas moves). Only queued and waiting are not final.

A script run answers run_script's text block: script-N and its state (done, REPORT, stopped, killed, or running with the line and what it waits on), the returned value, and the footer so far, with its cost line.
